[Legendary Mystic Enchant] By Fire Be Purged is now an Epic Mystic Enchantment from Legendary.

6.description: [Mythic+] Pending Restart - Corrected an issue where creatures killed by Murmur as part of his out of combat ambient events inside The Shadow Labyrinth would cause the dungeon to lose eligibility for a Mythic+ Key to start. Murmur will now start his ambient events 5 minutes after a player entered the dungeon. The Shadow Labyrinth Keystones will be re enabled later today.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Stagger''s damage could be influenced by some stats of the player. It should now always deal correct damage.

You can now only purchase up to 100 Scroll of **STAT** from Darkmoon Faire before having to trade or mail them off. This alongside the other changes should help unpromote semi-afk-vendor-buying while making sure this is not the best way to obtain your **STAT** scrolls while additionally being more accessible to everyone.
Darkmoon Faire now regenerates Scroll of **STAT** Stock 3x Faster than before.
Increased the buy price (the price which you buy) Scrolls from Darkmoon Faire. The price which they were sold at to vendors remains unchanged.
Inscribed Scroll Cases will now drop **STAT VI** scrolls instead of STAT V scrolls.

Level 65+ Creatures will now additionally drop Scroll of **STAT** VI scrolls in amounts of 1 to 3 (depending on difficulty of creature) from the same rate they they dropped **STAT V** scrolls. These creatures can still also drop **STAT V** scrolls.

6.description: [Mythic+] Fixed an issue causing overflow on some creatures on Alar. This would result in Balnazzar on Mythic9 to oneshot or other damaging spells to kill players extremely fast.

0.description: [Area-52] [TBC] Mythic0 Dungeons no longer require attunement quests to enter. Just item level. This change was made to help reduce friction especially when grouped with friends upon entering dungeons and compatibility for every keystone you can get.

1.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the Conflagrate DoT was unable crit. This effect was previously tied to the Improved Immolate Talent. It now has a capstone bonus reflecting its current behavior.

3.description: [Website] Implemented feature allowing users to sort the Bug Tracker by pressing the column headers.

6.description: [Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Reduced the extra damage dealt by Burning Blade to 10% Weapon damage down from 20%.
[Area 52] [Serpernt Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj] Pending Restart - Increased the base Physical damage of Lady Vashj and all creatures involved in the encounter by 30%.

[Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Warp Slicer now has a 1 second GCD on its Warp Slice proc and the maximum amount of stacks has been reduced to 25 down from 100.

[Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Cosmic Infuser now requires a triggering spell to have a mana cost.
[Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Quadruplet the total damage absorbed by Mana Shield on all difficulties.
[Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Increased the base Physical damage of Kaelthas Sunstrider and all creatures involved into the encounter by 30% on all difficulties.
[Area 52] [The Eye] [Kaelthas Sunstrider] Pending Restart - Increased the base health of Kaelthas Sunstrider and all creatures involved into the encounter by 11% on all difficulties.
[Area 52] [The Eye] Pending Restart - Reduced Health and Physical damage dealt by all creatures inside The Eye by 13% on Ascended Difficulty.

7.description:
[Frozen Chaos] - Polished the tooltip it now reads off as: 

Your Frostbolt and Ice Lance critical hits grant you a charge of Frozen Chaos and resets the cooldown of Chaos Bolt. You can store up to 3 charges of Frozen Chaos.

Frozen Chaos increases the damage of your Chaos Bolt by 20% and the spell power scaling by 40% while additionally causing it to incur no cooldown.

Casting Conflagrate grants you Splintered Chaos, causing your Chaos Bolts to hit an additional target. In addition, your Conflagrate triggers your Fingers of Frost (if known).
[Frozen Chaos] - The Splintered Chaos buff from Frozen Chaos will no longer additionally apply immolate to targets hit by your Chaos Bolt.

[Prophet of Wrath] [Pending Restart] - Prophet of Wrath now increases the critical strike damage of Holy and Arcane spells by 20% down from 25%. Prophet of Wrath has been a clear-cut contender and over-performing in many encounters since the caster talent rework and boost of 25% critical strike damage was added.

[Pending Restart] - [Predatory Nature] Now grants 2 combo points down from 5 when fully stacked and used on players. The Random Enchantment now reads off as: 

Consuming Predators Swiftness restores 10 energy and gives you a stack of Predatory Nature. Reaching three stacks increases the critical strike chance of your next spell cast through Predators Swiftness by 100% and causes it to grant 5 (2 to players) combo points.

[New Epic Enchantment] - [Shadow Core] Casting Mind Blast while Molten Core is active will activate your Shadow Core, restoring Molten Core to 3 charges.

Casting Mind Blast without Molten Core active will grant you 1 charge of Molten Core and causes Shadow Core to go on cooldown for 10 seconds. While on cooldown, your chance to proc Molten Core from Corruption is increased by 5%.

[New Epic Enchantment] - [Predatory Nature] Consuming Predators Swiftness restores 10 energy and gives you a stack of Nature of Madness. Reaching three stacks increases the critical strike chance of your next spell cast through Predators Swiftness by 100% and causes it to grant 5 combo points.
Predators Wrath now reduces damage done of your Wrath by 20% from 10% in PvP.

Predators Wrath has been reworked. It no longer prevents your wrath from critically striking. The reworked RE now reads as follows:

Your Predatory Strikes effect now lets you cast Wrath without leaving Cat Form. Wraths cast this way are unable to miss, but its damage is increased by 12% of your attack power. In addition, they will also restore 30 energy and 15% of your base mana, and gives you Predators Wrath. Predators Wrath causes all your Cat Form abilities to deal additional Nature damage, this effect lasts for 6 seconds.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Arcane Blast now deals 5% less base damage at level 60. This scaling of this ability is unchanged. The base damage of this spell is unchanged at level 70.
[Pending Restart] Arcane Missiles now deals 5% less base damage at level 60. This scaling of this ability is unchanged. The base damage of this spell is unchanged at level 70.
[Pending Restart] Impact stun now lasts for 1.5 sec, changed from 2 sec.
[Pending Restart] Metamorphosis now increases damage done versus players by 10%, changed from 15%.

7.description: Fixed an issue where Wind Strike could be used in feral forms.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Fan of Knives was not giving you the "Out of Knives" debuff.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the tooltip of Empowerment of Light was not stating it was reducing the mana cost of Smite or Flash Heal.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Empowerment of Light was not reducing mana cost of smite.

6.description: [Area 52] Pending Restart - Requires Cache clear to be displayed - Increased the Item Level of all items dropped by Doomlord Kazzak and Doomwalker to 125 up from 120.

5.description: [Pending Patch] High-Risk Materials will now be listed under their proper material categories when searched on the Auction House.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Lava Sweep was gaining to much scaling on Fire Blast, Pyroblast and Flame Shock when used against players. Additionally, Lava Sweep now does 20% reduced damage in PvP, from 25% reduced damage in PvP.

1.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the tooltip of Surge of Light was not stating it was reducing the mana cost of Smite or Flash Heal.

6.description:
Changed the Icon and Description of the Bloodforged Debuff in Flex Mode. It now has a distinct Icon and a more clear description. The new description is as follows: 

You are wearing Bloodforged or PvP items in PvE content. This debuff is only visible to you.

In Flex Normal difficulty this has no penalty. 

In Heroic and Ascended difficulties this will reduce damage done, healing done, and increase the damage taken by 20%.

7.description: Fixed an issue where the Attack Power to Spell Power conversion buff from Lava Sweep was artificially supplying you with 5% melee and spell critical strike chance despite not being listed in the tooltip of the LRE.
Fixed an issue where, under rare circumstances, Frozen Power random enchantment would not add damage to targets affected by Frostbrand.

1.description: [Pending Restart] The Flames of the Apostate damage over time effect is now dispellable.

Earth Shock will now stack from multiple casters. This means that you can now have multiple people in the same group using Earth Shock without worry of them overriding yours. (Mainly affecting builds that use the following enchantments: Elemental Assassin, Swarming Stings).

Improved Stormstrike debuff for increased Fire and Frost damage will now stack from multiple casters. This means that you can now have multiple people in the same group using this talent without worry of them overriding yours.

5.description: [Pending Patch] Fixed an issue where leatherworkers could not learn some Battle Scarred Strap recipes.

0.description: Banshee Wail from the Banshee pet now deals 25% reduced damage vs players. (It was dealing too high damage even without any investment into it.)
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue that caused player's pet's spell casts to appear duplicated to player's clients. This issue was most noticeable when the pet's spell missed.

2.description: [High Risk] Fixed an issue where players could refine High-Risk materials out in the open world without being level 60, effectively bypassing the risk associated with doing so. You must be level 60 to use High-Risk Resource turnings as intended.

6.description: [Dungeons and Raids] - Fixed an issue where certain mobs would spam interrupts on you at a 100% chance of success when walking into melee range or being in combat with them.This chance has been significantly decreased and also has a cooldown.

5.description: [Pending Restart] [Vanilla PvP Progression] - Warrior Tier Set from Arena Rewards are now statted more akin to the Rogue Set but instead replacing the agility for strength. The agility/rogue set remains unchanged. We are looking into the other PvP sets as well to make changes that more align with the stat allocation system without disrupting the players who have already obtained and use these gear pieces.

0.description: [Pending Patch Update] - The description of the Remove Armor & Weapon Enchant vellums now more clearly states that it does not give back the enchantment that you removed.
[Pending Restart] - Rune of Metamorphosis will now work inside of Tree of Wrath and you will gain same the bonus as the Tree of Life.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Pure Shadow stacks can now additionally be gained from Shadow Burn and Shadow Word: Death.

[Pending Restart] Pure Shadow stacks are now gained on cast instead of hit. This means that you can use shadow fury right after you fire your tenth shadow bolt and you do not have to wait for it to hit the target. Overall, this change should smooth over the rotation and create more viability especially in fast-paced environments where sometimes your Shadow Bolt casts would not deal damage to a target as it died after you finished your cast but before the Shadow Bolt could hit the target.
[Pending Restart] Shadow Burn now scales 37.4% of your spell power up from 33.3%.
[Pending Restart] Shadow Bolt now scales 53.5% of your spell damage. Up from 48.9%.

[Pending Restart] [Astral Bomber Legendary Enchantment] - Lunar and Solar Bomber now provide 4% increased damage to spells from 3%. This means the damage increase to their respective spells is increased by 20% up from 15% per cast once Lunar and Solar bomber are fully stacked. Pair this with the new Natural Destruction epic RE to really pack a punch.
[Pending restart] The Frozen Chaos buff has been reduced to a 20% damage increase (from 25%) and 40% bonus spell damage scaling increase (from 50%).

Solar and Lunar Knight now increases the damage of your Wrath and Starfire by 20% per stack to players, changed from 50%. (It was overperforming due to the recent bug fixes, causing far too high instant burst in PvP).

1.description: [Pending Restart] Trueshot Aura is now a passive ability and will always be active after you learn it just like Rampage or Unleashed Rage.

7.description:
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue in Solar Eclipse not always increasing the damage of Wrath when accompanied with the Astral Knight Buff - tooltip below:

Your Wrath damage is increased by 60% and 12% of your attack power. Your next Wrath will grant you Astral Attunement. Stacking twice.
[Pending Restart] - Solar and Lunar Knight will now increase the damage of your Wrath and Starfire by 50% to players down from 60%.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Knight of the Eclipse damage buffs was not always applying to Starfire or Wrath.
[Pending Restart] While Guardians of the Grove is active, your treants can now use Wild Growth again, however they will not use it as often as previously.
[Pending Restart] Blood Drinker now heals for 50% less while in a Feral form. (Due to ferals having increased attack power this RE was vastly overperforming.)
Fixed the buff tooltip of Shadow Strikes Mystic Enchant to clarify that it also increases your Shadow damage.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where ranged abilities could trigger Primordial Fury, from the Mystic Enchant Primordial Fury.
Fixed the tooltip of Unrelenting Wrath Mystic Enchant to state that it only works with tamed pets.
Fixed the tooltip of Unleashed Fury Mystic Enchant to state that it also works on dominated undead and enslaved demons.
Fixed the tooltip of On the Hunt Mystic Enchant to state that it also works on dominated undead and enslaved demons.
Fixed an issue where Raising Hell Mystic Enchant worked on enslaved demons.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Everlasting Affliction now reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 1/2/3 sec, changed from 2/4/6 sec.
Fixed the tooltip of Arcane Flows to clarify that it increases all Magic damage.
Fixed the buff tooltip of Berserk to also state the cost reduction in Cat Form and Bear Form.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the heal of Holy Shock was reduced to 30 yards. It is now 40 yards like other heals.

[Pending Restart] Significantly reduced the mana cost of many of the pet spells from Enslaved Demon and Dominate Undead. This will allow mana pets to be more equal to their energy counterparts in longer fights.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where spreading Insect Swarm and Insect Swarm (Plague) with Nature's Reach would not always apply the critical strike chance debuff from Improved Insect Swarm.

[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where having Improved Insect Swarm would give Insect Swarm Plague an unintended flat damage bonus. (This bug affected level 60 more than level 70 players. Resulting in a ~5% nerf of Insect Swarm (Plague))
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Improved Insect Swarm Capstone critical strike chance debuff would sometimes not apply. It now has a visible debuff that is trackable.
Fixed the tooltip of Kill Command to state that it only applies to tamed pets.
Fixed the tooltip of Spirit Bond to clarify it also works with enslaved demons and dominated undead pets.
Fixed the tooltip of Focused Fire to clarify the effect works for both the player and the pet. In addition, added dominated undead and enslaved demon to the effect and tooltip

6.description: [Mythic+] Bees will now stack up every 5 seconds from every 4 seconds.
